description:
Manufacturing cost & profit calculator for EVE Online — T1/T2 invention, T3, reactions, sourcing, multi-character industry planning.


Added
- Job notifications. While the app is open it watches your whole roster's
  industry jobs and raises a system notification the moment one finishes —
  "Sabre ×5 ready to deliver — Beulea". Works across all logged-in characters,
  never replays old jobs on startup, and can be turned off in the character
  menu (Job notifications).
- Reaction times & slot planning (player request): every step in the
  reaction plan shows its job length, and the plan sums it up — total slot-time,
  the dependency floor (critical path), and how long YOUR reaction slots
  (1 + Mass Reactions + Advanced Mass Reactions, from your imported skills)
  take to run the whole chain. Times use your Reactions skill (−4%/level), the
  Tatara's −25% bonus and your fitted reactor Time Efficiency rigs — which were
  in the rig picker but didn't move a number until now.
